description: This Java source file defines the class ConnectionUnavailableException, a specific exception class used in the context of connectivity within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a particular connection exists but is temporarily unavailable. The class includes methods for constructing instances, including from messages and JSON objects, and provides a builder class for customization.

classes.name: ConnectionUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a specific connection is not available at the moment. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException. It provides static factory methods for creating instances from messages and JSON objects, and supports a builder pattern for customization.

classes.name: ConnectionUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of ConnectionUnavailableException with a fluent API. It allows setting message, description, cause, href, and dittoHeaders, and builds the exception object.

methods.name: ConnectionUnavailableException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance initialized with a given ConnectionId.

methods.name: ConnectionUnavailableException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionUnavailableException instance with a provided message and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionUnavailableException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionUnavailableException instance by parsing the error message from a JSON object and including given headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers, preserving other details.
